verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's docs define templates as reusable blueprints covering image, resources, environment, metadata and network policy. They also state that public and team-scoped private images are imported for runtime use, and that the s0 CLI supports image build/push and template updates in CI. Together these cover both custom templates and bring-your-own-image. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building and using a custom image/template.
